column1: # The walks' known failures (order 1994). scripts/walk_ratchet.py says what
# each column means and how a walk judges against the list. The list only
# shrinks: a line whose failure passes fails the walk until it is removed.
# Wall-clock rules (frame_p95) are never listed: every run counts them.
# First generation at 4fa1fe818 (2026-11-17) from one full render walk, two
# quick render walks, one full and one quick load walk (the two quick render
# walks gave the same failures apart from the wall clock). first_seen says
# "failing at", not "failing since". Every line is owned by order 1994 until
# a repair order or an issue takes its rule over.
